This project is a minimal Next.js 14 app for ENGLISH LEARNERS (myenglishlearners.in) to publish ISC and ICSE 2025 student results. It uses Tailwind CSS v4 and pnpm. The main page displays sortable/filterable tables for both ISC and ICSE, allows toggling between them, highlights the top 10 students, and supports color scheme switching. Data will be imported from a file later.
